title: The Star Card in the Barn
lines: Dan and Dad park the car by the farm.
Dan starts to dig in the dark barn.
He finds a card in a dusty jar.
The card has a big gold star on it.
It is hard to spot in the dark.
Dan runs to the yard with it.
The star is red and gold in the sun.
Dad grins at the card for a long time.
That card was his on this farm.
Dan hugs Dad in the yard.

questions.ask: What did Dan find in the jar?
questions.listenFor: A card with a big gold star on it. Point back to the line if they guess, rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why did Dan run out to the yard?
questions.listenFor: It was too dark in the barn to see the card. The story says so one line above, so this is a two-line hunt.

questions.ask: How do you think Dad felt when he saw the card? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. Listen for the grin, or for the card being his when he was small on this same farm.
